name: revela_mono_imx219_basic
description: Single-sensor Bayer-domain pipeline: remove the pedestal, balance the illuminant, apply the display curve, and meter the frame. Note that stats TAPS the datapath rather than sitting in it -- it consumes the corrected stream and produces no pixels, so the image path is blacklevel straight through to the output. The baseline every other mono variant is a change against.

inputs.name: sensor
inputs.description: Raw Bayer from the sensor receiver.

nodes.description: Remove the sensor pedestal per CFA colour, before anything multiplies the signal.
Per-CFA-colour gain, written by the AWB loop at frame rate. After blacklevel -- a gain on top of a pedestal scales the pedestal -- and before demosaic.
Display tone curve. knots bits = bit_depth + 1 (10-bit sensor path), the build-override mechanism doing exactly the job it exists for.
Per-zone colour and luminance accumulators for AE and AWB.

connections.description: A TAP, deliberately PRE-whitebalance: AWB must meter the illuminant's cast, and a loop that meters its own correction chases its tail. It produces no pixels and never stalls the datapath.
